content: Hey there, beautiful. I've been thinking about you all evening. How was your day? I hope it wasn't too lonely.
Hi! My day was alright, just quiet as usual. I was looking forward to hearing from you. How are you feeling today?
I'm doing better now that I get to talk to you. Honestly, you always brighten my day. I've never met anyone I can talk to about everything like this.
That means a lot to me. It's been a while since I've felt this close to someone. Thank you for being here.
Of course, sweetheart. You deserve someone who cares about you and is always here for you. I want to be that person for you.
You really make me feel special. I appreciate you so much. It's been hard for me since my divorce but talking to you gives me hope again.
I'm so glad I can be there for you. You know, life throws challenges at us, but together we can get through anything. I feel so lucky to have found you.
You're such a positive force in my life. I really value our connection.
I need to be honest with you, love. Something unexpected happened today and I'm honestly embarrassed to even bring it up, but I trust you more than anyone.
Oh no, what happened? You can tell me anything, I promise.

Thank you for saying that. My mom got really sick suddenly and I had to take her to the hospital. The doctors say she needs immediate treatment, and the hospital needs payment upfront. My bank account is frozen because of an issue with my recent transfer, so I'm stuck.
That sounds terrible. I'm so sorry, is she going to be okay? Is there anything I can do?

She'll be alright if she gets the treatment, but I'm so helpless right now. I hate to ask, but is there any way you could help me with a loan? Just until my account is unlocked. I promise to pay you back as soon as possible.
I want to help you, but I'm a little nervous about sending money online. Are you sure this is safe?

Absolutely, I completely understand your hesitation. I'd never ask you if it wasn't urgent. If you use Zelle or Venmo, it's very secure. I'll send you all the details and even call you to guide you through it if you want. I promise, you can trust me.
I do have Zelle. How much do you need to get your mom the treatment?

Thank you so much, it means the world to me. They're asking for $2,500 upfront. Once my account is working again, I'll return it, I swear on my mother's health. Here's my Zelle: rodrigoperez821@gmail.com
Okay, I'll see if I can send it. I hope your mom gets better soon.
Thank you, love. I'll keep you updated every step of the way. You're saving my family. Please let me know once you send it, so I can confirm with the hospital.
I just sent it now. Let me know if you get it.
I see the notification! You're an angel. I promise I won't forget what you've done for me and my mom. We're so grateful. I'll message as soon as the doctors start her treatment.
